text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've declared my comeback, I want 
to show them. My complete revival. To 
every living soul out there. And standing 
in my way is...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are the Great Wall of China. 
The one tasked with swallowing all my 
madness. Then I shall overcome you with 
the strength and speed of a thunder god.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
O steadfast, jet-black warrior. I shall 
show you a realm beyond destiny. With my 
brilliance, rekindled through death and 
rebirth!
